correctness.rationale: PASS: From |x|=1 obtain two x signs and r=y roots of r^2-r+a=0, with z=-xy. I independently expanded det(lambda I-J_s(r)) for s=+/-1 symbolically: lambda^3+(1-r^2)lambda^2+(1-r)lambda+(1-2r). The exact cubic Hurwitz determinant factors AB-C=r(r^2-r+1), whose sign is the sign of r. Hence on 0<a<1/4 the r_- pair (0<r<1/2) is Hurwitz and r_+ pair (1/2<r<1) has one RHP root. For a<0, r_+ has one RHP and r_- two; at a=0 the r_- spectrum is -1,+/-i; at a=1/4 zero plus -3/8 +/- i sqrt(23)/8, and a>1/4 none. On the Hurwitz r_- branch the strict commensurate Caputo spectral-angle criterion also holds for every 0<q<=1. All statements are local, with the non-differentiability at x=0 irrelevant because equilibria have |x|=1.
